segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Too expensive!] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đắt quá!] [EN: I will go.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi sẽ đi.] [EN: Bus.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Xe buýt.] [EN: See you tomorrow, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mai gặp nha.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Nghen.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: A warm okay.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: You know] [VI: hơn] [EN: from] [VI: nói chậm hơn,] [EN: speak slower. To compare, put it after the adjective.] [VI_F: Hơn.] [EN: a flat tone. Cheaper is] [VI: rẻ hơn.] [EN: This is cheaper than that.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái này rẻ hơn cái đó.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To say as much as, or equal to, use] [VI_F: Bằng.] [EN: a falling tone. This is as big as that.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái này lớn bằng cái đó.] [EN: For the most, the -est, use] [VI_F: Nhất.] [EN: a high, rising tone, after the adjective. The cheapest.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rẻ nhất.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. More, or -er.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Hơn.] [EN: Equal to.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Bằng.] [EN: Most.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Nhất.] [EN: This is cheaper.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái này rẻ hơn.] [EN: The cheapest.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rẻ nhất.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Nhất.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Most, -est.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Bằng.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Equal to, as ... as.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen at a stall.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Cái nào rẻ hơn?] [VI_F: Dạ, cái này rẻ nhất.] [VI_M: Vậy cho tôi cái này.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say this is cheaper than that.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái này rẻ hơn cái đó.] [EN: Say the cheapest.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rẻ nhất.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you compare two options out loud. The preview phrase is] [VI: lớn hơn] [EN: which means bigger.]
